speaker: The Chairman
text: Third Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the financial year 1 April 2020 to 31 March 2021, contained in Paper Cmd 3 of 2020.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I shall deal first with the Head of Expenditure in respect of which an amendment stands on the Order Paper Supplement.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
text: Mr Chairman, facilities, such as Community Care Facilities, Government Quarantine Facilities, Stay Home Notice Dedicated Facilities and temporary accommodation for migrant workers were set up at very short notice at the start of the COVID-19 crisis.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
text: These facilities played a critical role in breaking the infection cycle.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
text: It was a tremendous undertaking by all parties involved.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
text: While the number of cases in Singapore has since declined steadily, we are now taking careful steps to allow more social and economic activities to resume, and to re-open our borders.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
text: Therefore, in tandem, we have returned various facilities to their pre-COVID uses.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
text: However, as shown by experiences elsewhere in the world, we cannot afford to let our guard down.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
text: We must assess the risk of each step carefully and ensure that we have sufficient options and buffer capacity to meet various contingency scenarios, including a resurgence of cases.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
text: This has always been our approach – looking ahead and putting in place robust plans to deal with contingencies.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
text: To conclude, to Mr Leong's questions, COVID-19 pandemic is an unprecedented public health crisis that has affected Singapore and the world.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How)
text: We would like to express our gratitude to the many public officers and private sector partners that had worked tirelessly to set up various COVID-19 facilities at short notice.

speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
text: Mr Chairman, I thank Minister of State Tan for the clarification.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I shall now deal with the remaining heads of expenditure in respect of which no amendment stands on the Order Paper Supplement.

speaker: The Chairman
text: In respect of the Third Supplementary Main Estimates, they are Heads V, W, X and Z.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I propose to take those Heads of Expenditure en bloc.
